findings.model: mixed Cogeser-owned AC Quick plus at least one Cogeser-owned DC Rapid; direct tariff cannot be promoted network-wide

coveredPopulation.rule: IT*CGS EVSE deterministically identified as Cogeser Quick AC are rankable at 0.67 EUR/kWh VAT included
coveredPopulation.channel: direct Cogeser / spot QR; customer tariff page

uncoveredPopulation.rule: Cogeser-owned DC EVSE remain fail-closed until an exact current direct Cogeser DC tariff is published or exposed by QR/app/backend
uncoveredPopulation.knownExample: Inzago Via Leonardo Sciascia: Circontrol Rapid 25 kW DC, first Cogeser-owned DC installation, inaugurated 2025-11-25
uncoveredPopulation.reason: Current official tariff page lists 0.67 EUR/kWh only for 'Quick Cogeser Energia' AC. Its 0.89 EUR/kWh DC row explicitly applies to non-Cogeser roaming stations, so it cannot be transposed to Cogeser's own DC charger.

negativePaths: Do not assume all 60 IT*CGS EVSE are Quick AC: official Cogeser evidence proves a Cogeser-owned 25 kW DC charger exists.
Do not use 0.89 EUR/kWh as Cogeser direct DC price: official tariff table scopes it to non-Cogeser roaming DC.
Do not reuse older Neogy/Cogeser 0.55/0.67/0.73 tariff PDF as current direct pricing without current applicability proof.
findings.resumeCondition: Use PUN connector/current/power data to split IT*CGS AC vs DC deterministically. Promote AC Quick subset at 0.67 EUR/kWh. For DC, inspect Cogeser QR/app/backend for current direct tariff; otherwise retain fail-closed.

coherence.classificationChange: CGS remains partial/class-wide, but all-Quick hypothesis is disproved and covered/uncovered populations are now explicit.
